description: Implementation of tensor empty and size calculation functions in ATen library for PyTorch, including memory allocation strategies and support for symbolic sizes.

classes.name: MetaAllocator
classes.description: A custom allocator that always returns nullptr, used for meta tensors.

methods.name: GetCPUAllocatorMaybePinned
methods.description: Returns a CPU allocator, optionally pinned, based on the pin_memory flag.

methods.name: raise_warning_for_complex_half
methods.description: Issues a warning if the data type is complex half.

methods.name: computeStorageNbytesContiguous
methods.description: Calculates the number of bytes needed for a contiguous tensor storage.

methods.name: computeStorageNbytes
methods.description: Calculates the number of bytes needed for a tensor storage given sizes and strides.

methods.name: computeStorageNbytesContiguous (SymInt version)
methods.description: Calculates storage bytes for symbolic sizes contiguously.

methods.name: computeStorageNbytes (SymInt version)
methods.description: Calculates storage bytes for symbolic sizes and strides.

methods.name: _empty_generic
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized tensor with specified size and allocator.

methods.name: _empty_strided_generic
methods.description: Creates an uninitialized strided tensor with specified size and stride.

methods.name: empty_cpu
methods.description: Creates an empty CPU tensor with specified size and options.

methods.name: empty_strided_cpu
methods.description: Creates an empty strided CPU tensor with specified size, stride, and options.

methods.name: empty_meta
methods.description: Creates a meta tensor (no storage) with specified size and dtype.

methods.name: empty_strided_meta
methods.description: Creates a strided meta tensor with specified size, stride, and dtype.

methods.name: empty_symint_meta
methods.description: Creates a symbolic size meta tensor.

methods.name: empty_strided_symint_meta
methods.description: Creates a symbolic size strided meta tensor.
